/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys,json,os,fcntl,termios,struct
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
p=float((d.get("context_window") or {}).get("used_percentage") or 0)
m=(d.get("model") or {}).get("display_name") or "Claude"
try:
 f=os.open("/dev/tty",os.O_RDONLY)
 w=struct.unpack("hh",fcntl.ioctl(f,termios.TIOCGWINSZ,b"0000"))[1]
except Exception:
 w=int(os.environ.get("COLUMNS") or 80)
h="{} | ctx {:.0f}% ".format(m,p)
n=max(5,w-len(h)-6)
k=min(n,int(round(n*p/100)))
print(h+"["+"\u2588"*k+"\u2591"*(n-k)+"]")'
